scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs && concurrently -n cjs,esm -c blue,magenta "tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
